Title: Esme’s Big Day
Content: The sky above is clear and bright,
But I am filled with doubt and fright.
Soccer tryouts are here today.
Will I shine bright, or will my dream fade away?
“I am ready!” I bellow inside my head,
but I mostly wish I were back in bed.
The grassy field is an endless sea,
My legs shake as I wonder, “Is this really me?”
The other girls seem sure and strong.
I am not certain if I even belong.
We stand in a line—the ball smacks the ground.
Thump-thump! Thump-thump! My heart starts to pound.
“Esme!” Coach calls. “Kick the ball toward the goal!”
I kick it and kick it and watch it roll.
I dash down the field as fast as the breeze.
There is an opportunity here to seize.
I smack the ball, and it sails to the net!
But then it goes wild, so I am upset.
I try again—this time it goes in!
`ultext(beam)` ear to ear and hold up my chin.
I watch as the other girls each take a turn.
They are so good; I know I still have a lot to learn.
They dash and they dart—it’s almost a dance.
I think I can do it—just give me a chance!
My heart is as light as a fluffy, white cloud.
Someday soon I will play before a huge crowd.
The `text(weeks)` will drag by until that wonderful `text(day)`.
I cannot wait, I cannot wait! I am ready to play!
